title: The Tout Terrain Catalina 29er is a Hardtail Touring Bike
content:
There’s a new name in Tout Terrain’s adventure-bike lineup, and its launch signals two key firsts for the German brand: the first derailleur-based 29er and the first model to be offered as a standalone frame kit. Meet the Catalina ($4,099), a steel-frame bikepacking hardtail designed to go from afternoon trail laps to big backcountry overnighters and beyond…

Tout Terrain Catalina 29er Quick Hits

  • Frame: Tout Terrain Thermocrom steel with Matte Black finish
  • Fork: RockShox Reba Gold 120mm
  • Groupset: Shimano Deore 1×12 drivetrain
  • Wheelset: WTB KOM Tough i30 29” with Tout Terrain hubs
  • Seatpost: OneUp V3 150mm dropper post
  • Sizes: S, M, L, XL
  • Select model price: $4,099 / €3.199

Teased at this year’s Sea Otter Classic, the Catalina feels fast and fun on flowy trails—while maintaining the key pillars of capability, long-distance comfort, and long-term durability. Staying true to the brand’s touring roots, the Catalina features multiple mounting points throughout its powder-coated Thermocrom frame, making it easier to add bags and accessories for extended trips off the grid.

For the launch, Tout Terrain is introducing the Catalina in an approachable yet capable Select 7.1 configuration, with a price point that appeals to first-time bikepackers and seasoned explorers alike. Details include a RockShox 120mm suspension fork, 2.4” Continental tires, and a OneUp 150mm dropper post to easily tackle rough, technical terrain. The Shimano Deore 1×12 groupset ensures fast, reliable shifting—while keeping Tout Terrain’s entry into the category accessible for most customers.

The Catalina is also available as a customizable frame kit in the customer’s choice of color, starting at $1,625 / € 1.300.

Preorders placed for Select 7.1 models and custom frame kits are expected to begin shipping before the end of the year.
